run_get_image_metas: run the script to collect image metas from a dataset config and save to a pkl file
create_parse_args: create a function that parses command-line arguments for config, dataset split, output file, and number of processes
build_get_metas_csv: build a function that reads a CSV-style annotation file and extracts unique image filenames
build_get_metas_txt: build a function that reads a TXT-style annotation file and extracts image filenames with skip-line logic
test_get_image_metas: test the function that loads an image from a path, reads its bytes, and returns filename and original shape
